input.Gemini Conversation History Instructions:
Takeout upload flow for the LT interface:

Create a common Google Drive folder for uploading Takeout files.
For each task, the rater should creat a subfolder using Task ID + their Name.
The trainer will be uploading the the  Takeout file to that task folder and paste the Takeout file link under Gemini Conversation History. For Long-Term and relevant Short-Term, the same existing Takeout can be uploaded across task folders.
For Super Short-Term, the rater first creates the required Gemini conversation, then runs Takeout again so the new conversation is included. This updated Takeout should be uploaded to that task folder and link of this takeout file should be copy pasted in Gemini Conversation History.
input.Google Drive Link Instructions: Create a folder in the provided Google Drive link using: [YourName]-[TaskID] Example: JohnDoe-12345 Upload all required files (HTML & Debug Info) to your respective folder. HTML file name: Use the HTML name already provided in the metadata (Column F). Debug TXT file name: Use the format HTMLName_Debuginfo_turn1.
input.L2: Sub-Use Case (extended definition):
The user asks Gemini to generate or surface new options the user hasn't yet identified, personalized to their situation.

Boundary: Gemini generates the candidate set — the user has not provided specific options to evaluate (→ Evaluation). The output is a list of concrete, choosable entities, not open-ended advice (→ Advice & Perspective) or a general explanation (→ Explanation).

The ultimate test: Is the user saying "suggest things for me" rather than "judge these specific things"?

• What headphones should I buy?
• Could you suggest where I should go for a quick getaway?
• What should I watch tonight?
• What mentorship program should I join?
• Is there a good workout I should start with?
• What course should I take to learn coding?
• What should I cook tonight?
